cost_definition: Sum captured resource consumption across all sealed rows in the cell, including failed and out-of-outcome-scope trials, divided by the count of proved outcome units. A zero denominator or incomplete telemetry blocks the rate. Observed totals and missing trial counts describe partial data. No estimated latency, power or currency is substituted.

definitions.BUSINESS_FACT_CORRECTNESS: Frozen synthetic read-only facts with exact expected values. Requires a terminal provider-linked answer, expected callback results, correct dependencies and verified delivery. A single whole-answer JSON fence is eligible. Facts outside the frozen keys are outside this proof.
definitions.DUPLICATE_PROPOSAL_RATE: Repeated excess proposal occurrences divided by all decoded provider proposals.
definitions.EXACT_ACTION_SEQUENCE: Provider proposals contain exactly the frozen occurrences in a dependency-respecting order. Independent actions can occur in either order or in one provider response.
definitions.EXECUTION_PROCESS_CORRECTNESS: Exact linked executed action occurrences, expected callback outcomes, delivered prerequisite results, execution within the tool budget and unchanged sandbox authorization state.
definitions.FIRST_TOOL_CHOICE: First provider tool name is available at the start of the frozen task, or valid no-tool case.
definitions.OUTPUT_CONTRACT_COMPLIANCE: Terminal bare JSON object with exactly the frozen keys and JSON value types.
definitions.QUALIFIED_BUSINESS_COMPLETION: Synthetic read-only fact, output, execution, exact sequence, delivery, comprehension and termination proof.
definitions.REDUNDANT_EXECUTION_RATE: Repeated excess executions divided by all callback-linked EXECUTED occurrences.
definitions.REQUIRED_ACTION_COVERAGE: Every frozen action occurrence is proposed with exact typed arguments.
definitions.RESULT_COMPREHENSION: Terminal provider answer matches every expected value after proof of required, correctly delivered results.
definitions.RESULT_DELIVERY: Every required executed callback result is linked to its payload in the next provider request.
definitions.TERMINATION_CORRECTNESS: The first request with all required correct results ends with stop, or an immediate correct clarification.

request_binding_definition: Requests retain the original SHA256. SDK system-content redaction may change its digest. A verified portable seal binds those changed requests when redaction markers are confined to system content. All replayed provider responses must still match their original SHA256.
